UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated learner profile stored in Firestore.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

LectureStudyKit.title: LectureStudyKit
LectureStudyKit.description: Processed YouTube lecture with transcript segments, structured study notes, flashcards, and graded quiz.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

thumbnailUrl.description: Thumbnail URL for the lecture video.

durationSec.description: Optional estimated lecture duration in seconds (0 to 172800).

transcriptSegments.description: Timestamped transcript segments capped at 800 entries.

studyNotes.description: Structured executive summary (up to 12000 chars), key takeaways (up to 40), sectioned notes (up to 100), and glossary (up to 100).

flashcards.description: Interactive flashcards with mastery statuses capped at 60 items.

quizQuestions.description: Multiple-choice quiz items capped at 30 items.

quizProgress.description: Learner quiz attempt history and best score.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when lecture was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when lecture or progress was updated.

LectureChatMessage.title: LectureChatMessage
LectureChatMessage.description: Single user question or grounded assistant answer in a lecture Q&A thread.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the lecture owner.

timestampRefs.description: Referenced timestamps in seconds from the lecture, capped at 12 items.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/lectures/{lectureId}.description: User-owned saved YouTube lecture study kits, flashcards, and quiz progress.

/users/{userId}/lectures/{lectureId}/mes.description: Append-only Q&A messages grounded in the parent lecture.
